ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.13 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.13: local magic density, timed astral tears, manifestations that yield essences or hostile monsters, and Astral Loot to extract an essence from a manifested monster corpse. Also features ranked progression, randomized attributes and configurable 2–5 slots per essence. Experimental RimWorld 1.7 mod; test saves recommended.
